title: packaging·품질·격리·복구 출시 gate

schema_change.rationale: readiness computation is pure evaluation over existing WP evidence; durable records reuse the WP02 ledger

verification.ruff: 0 findings in WP22-owned paths under cyrano/configs/quality/ruff.toml
verification.formatter: ruff format --check clean on WP22-owned paths
verification.dev_check: dev.py check exit 0 after docs regeneration
verification.quality_gate: dev.py quality exit 0; line audit 0 findings across the whole 79/72 scope (baseline debt fully fixed, no waiver)
verification.release_check: release_check.py exit 0; verified_points 40, unevaluated 0, release_eligible false

architecture.launch: feature stages off->observe_only->isolated_shadow->gated_canary->enabled; unconfigured features are off and unknown stages raise FEATURE_STAGE_UNKNOWN; shadow runs with real effects are refused; staged migration commits all or none; restores replay tombstones before activation and refuse old writers; reader/writer version conflicts are typed errors
architecture.release_check: indexes all successful WP evidence, matches each rubric criterion's mandatory case ids globally, computes 40 verified points across all 15 criteria, inspects the built wheel for required assets and forbidden entries, reads the real quality gate result, and blocks eligibility on every unrun required gate
architecture.quality: quality.py records real tool identities (path/sha256/version), runs ruff format --check, ruff check and ty at the pinned 79/72 config, persists raw stdout/stderr digests, exits 2 with a blocked report when tools are missing, and never claims full PEP8 compliance

review_findings_resolved: Mapping used with isinstance but only imported under TYPE_CHECKING -> runtime import
quality.py leaked the style-audit subprocess output onto stdout, producing two JSON documents -> audit output captured into evidence files, stdout carries one report
ty invalid-argument errors on Mapping.get object values -> isinstance narrowing
UNKNOWN_STAGE collided with WP00-owned document_route code -> FEATURE_STAGE_UNKNOWN
normalize_test_outcome reported passed for an all-skipped run when required==0 -> unconditional not_applicable
find_swallowed_errors missed a bare `except:` (no exception type) -> regex now covers it
git ls-files in packaging_report lacked a subprocess timeout -> timeout added
wheel identity was not digest-bound in the readiness report -> sha256 recorded
check_integrated rejected the legitimate computed_from_wp_evidence scorecard status -> accepts it while still refusing a fabricated official_score
the missing-tools drill overwrote the real quality.json, corrupting later evidence reads -> test restores the evidence after the drill
not_established: clean_env_install, permission_bypass_drill, disk_full_drill, key_rotation_drill, backup_restore_drill, install_nonmutation_drill, governed_screens, live_effectiveness remain not_run in release-readiness.json; release_eligible stays false until executed
official_score remains null; operator confirmation is a separate act
native clean-environment wheel install is asserted only as a not-run gate
actual branch protection and upstream ci.yml wiring are unmodified; required-job aggregation is verified at function level
signed artifact provenance (wheel is digest-bound, not signed)
